description.value:
You extend your ki into your kensei weapons, granting you the following benefits.

Magic Kensei Weapons. Your attacks with your kensei weapons count as magical for the purpose of overcoming Resistance and Immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

Deft Riposte. When you spend Ki on your Deflect Attack feature, you can attack with a monk weapon you are currently wielding instead of forcing the target to make a Dexterity Saving Throw, provided the target is within your reach.
